correctness.rationale: The monomial compression equals S^k; distinct correction matrix units have exactly rank r; U²=0, hence the kernel is (I+U)L. The explicitly surjective J has kernel exactly that graph, and J S* maps a complete graph basis onto exactly 2r+1 independent low-degree monomials, proving the minimal defect equals 2r+1 for every integer r≥1. The published Theorem 5.4 provides the matching universal upper bound. Finite exact rational computations are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The all-ranks sharpness of a newly proved universal bound is a motivated structural optimality question. Concrete monomial symbols and orthogonal matrix units make the lower bound transparent, showing the linear coefficient 2 and additive 1 cannot be improved even under severe finite-dimensional restrictions. This is a complete optimality result rather than a routine numerical special case.
